name: Tumor Protein p53
zh: 「基因组卫士」，感知 DNA 损伤后决定细胞修复还是凋亡，超过一半的人类癌症与它失活有关。
en: The 'guardian of the genome': after DNA damage it chooses repair or apoptosis; it is mutated in over half of human cancers.

name: Breast Cancer Gene 1
zh: 参与 DNA 双链断裂修复，有害突变显著增加乳腺癌与卵巢癌风险。
en: Repairs DNA double-strand breaks; harmful variants greatly raise breast and ovarian cancer risk.

name: Breast Cancer Gene 2
zh: 帮助 RAD51 装载到受损 DNA 上完成同源重组修复，突变导致遗传性乳腺癌。
en: Loads RAD51 onto damaged DNA for homologous recombination; variants cause hereditary breast cancer.

name: KRAS Proto-oncogene
zh: 细胞增殖信号通路上的分子开关，是人类癌症中最常突变的癌基因之一。
en: A molecular switch in growth signaling and one of the most frequently mutated oncogenes in human cancer.

name: Retinoblastoma Protein
zh: 第一个被发现的抑癌基因，把守细胞周期从 G1 期进入 S 期的大门。
en: The first tumor suppressor discovered; it gates the cell cycle's G1-to-S transition.

name: Adenomatous Polyposis Coli
zh: Wnt 通路的「刹车」，失活会让肠道息肉大量增生并走向肠癌。
en: A brake on Wnt signaling; its loss floods the colon with polyps that can turn cancerous.

name: Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor
zh: 接收生长信号的跨膜受体，肺癌靶向药吉非替尼就作用于它。
en: A growth-signal receptor; the lung-cancer drug gefitinib targets it.

name: MYC Proto-oncogene
zh: 调控约 15% 人类基因的转录因子，过度活跃会驱动肿瘤疯狂增殖。
en: A master transcription factor; when overactive it drives runaway tumor growth.

name: B-cell Lymphoma 2
zh: 抑制细胞凋亡的「生存开关」，最早在淋巴瘤中被发现。
en: An anti-apoptosis 'survival switch' first discovered in lymphoma.

name: Phosphatase and Tensin Homolog
zh: 拮抗 PI3K-AKT 生长信号的磷酸酶，失活后细胞增殖失控。
en: A phosphatase opposing PI3K–AKT growth signaling; its loss unleashes proliferation.

name: Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor A
zh: 血管新生的关键因子，肿瘤靠它「招兵买马」建立血液供应。
en: The key factor recruiting new blood vessels — tumors exploit it to feed themselves.

name: Telomerase Reverse Transcriptase
zh: 端粒酶的催化亚基，让癌细胞摆脱分裂次数限制获得「永生」。
en: The catalytic subunit of telomerase; it grants cancer cells limitless division.

name: Cyclin-dependent Kinase Inhibitor 2A
zh: 编码 p16 等细胞周期抑制蛋白，是黑色素瘤易感基因。
en: Encodes the p16 cell-cycle brake; variants predispose to melanoma.

name: HER2 Receptor
zh: 约两成乳腺癌因它扩增，靶向药赫赛汀由此而来。
en: Amplified in about 20% of breast cancers and targeted by the drug Herceptin.

name: B-Raf Proto-oncogene
zh: MAPK 通路激酶，V600E 突变常见于黑色素瘤与甲状腺癌。
en: A MAPK-pathway kinase; its V600E mutation drives melanoma and thyroid cancers.

name: MutL Homolog 1
zh: DNA 错配修复核心蛋白，缺陷导致林奇综合征。
en: A DNA mismatch-repair core protein; defects cause Lynch syndrome.

name: ATM Kinase
zh: 感知 DNA 双链断裂并拉响细胞警报的激酶。
en: The kinase that senses double-strand breaks and sounds the cellular alarm.

name: Hypoxia-inducible Factor 1 Alpha
zh: 缺氧响应的总开关，让细胞适应低氧，2019 年诺贝尔奖的主角之一。
en: The master switch of oxygen sensing, honored by the 2019 Nobel Prize.

name: CF Transmembrane Conductance Regulator
zh: 氯离子通道蛋白，ΔF508 突变导致囊性纤维化，是定位克隆的经典致病基因。
en: A chloride channel; its ΔF508 mutation causes cystic fibrosis.

name: Hemoglobin Subunit Beta
zh: 编码 β-珠蛋白，一个谷氨酸变缬氨酸就引发镰刀型贫血，AP 生物经典案例。
en: Encodes β-globin; a single Glu→Val change causes sickle-cell anemia.

name: Dystrophin
zh: 人体最大的基因之一，突变导致杜氏肌营养不良，也是基因疗法的热门靶点。
en: One of the largest human genes; mutations cause Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

name: Huntingtin
zh: CAG 三核苷酸重复异常扩增导致亨廷顿病，重复次数决定发病早晚。
en: Abnormal CAG-repeat expansion here causes Huntington's disease; repeat length sets onset age.

name: Fragile X Messenger Ribonucleoprotein 1
zh: CGG 重复扩增使 X 染色体「脆裂」，是最常见的遗传性智力障碍病因。
en: CGG expansion causes fragile X syndrome, a leading inherited intellectual disability.

name: Survival of Motor Neuron 1
zh: 功能缺失导致脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA），反义寡核苷酸药物可逆转病程。
en: Its loss causes spinal muscular atrophy; antisense drugs can now change the course.

name: Neurofibromin 1
zh: 抑癌兼 RAS 信号调节基因，突变引起神经纤维瘤病 I 型（牛奶咖啡斑）。
en: A Ras regulator; mutations cause neurofibromatosis type I.

name: Polycystin 1
zh: 突变导致常染色体显性多囊肾病，肾脏被无数囊肿占据。
en: Mutations cause dominant polycystic kidney disease.

name: Phenylalanine Hydroxylase
zh: 苯丙氨酸羟化酶，缺陷导致苯丙酮尿症（PKU），新生儿筛查的经典项目。
en: Its deficiency causes phenylketonuria (PKU), the classic newborn-screening disorder.

name: Hexosaminidase A
zh: 溶酶体酶缺陷导致 Tay-Sachs 病，脂质在神经元中异常堆积。
en: A lysosomal enzyme; its defect causes Tay-Sachs disease.

name: Glucose-6-phosphate Dehydrogenase
zh: 红细胞抗氧化防线，缺陷者吃蚕豆会溶血，分布与疟疾选择压力有关。
en: Red-cell antioxidant defense; deficiency causes favism and reflects malaria selection.

name: Coagulation Factor VIII
zh: 凝血因子 VIII，缺陷导致血友病 A，历史上曾困扰欧洲王室。
en: Factor VIII; its deficiency causes hemophilia A, the 'royal disease'.

name: Glucocerebrosidase
zh: 葡萄糖脑苷脂酶，缺陷导致戈谢病，也是帕金森病的重要风险基因。
en: Its deficiency causes Gaucher disease and raises Parkinson's risk.

name: Methyl-CpG Binding Protein 2
zh: 读取 DNA 甲基化标记的蛋白，突变导致 Rett 综合征。
en: Reads DNA methylation marks; mutations cause Rett syndrome.

name: Lamin A/C
zh: 核纤层蛋白，特定点突变导致儿童早衰症。
en: A nuclear lamina protein; a specific mutation causes progeria.

name: Collagen Type I Alpha 1
zh: I 型胶原主链，突变使骨骼脆弱（成骨不全症）。
en: The main chain of type I collagen; mutations cause brittle-bone disease.

name: Fibrillin 1
zh: 微纤维蛋白，突变导致马凡综合征：身材瘦高、晶状体脱位、主动脉瘤风险。
en: Mutations cause Marfan syndrome: tall stature, lens dislocation, aortic risk.

name: Insulin
zh: 胰岛素，1921 年被发现，1982 年成为首个用重组 DNA 技术生产的药物。
en: Insulin: discovered in 1921, the first recombinant-DNA drug in 1982.

name: Lactase
zh: 乳糖酶基因，部分人群因调控突变而终身保留消化乳糖的能力。
en: Lactase; regulatory variants let some adults keep digesting milk.

name: Apolipoprotein E
zh: 脂质运输蛋白，ε4 等位基因是阿尔茨海默病最强的常见遗传风险因子。
en: A lipid carrier; its ε4 allele is the strongest common genetic risk for Alzheimer's.

name: Leptin
zh: 脂肪细胞分泌的「饱腹激素」，缺乏它的小鼠会暴食肥胖。
en: The satiety hormone from fat cells; without it, mice overeat massively.

name: Fat Mass and Obesity-associated Protein
zh: 全基因组关联研究发现的首个肥胖易感基因，效应体现在食欲上。
en: The first obesity-susceptibility gene found by GWAS; it acts through appetite.

name: Glucokinase
zh: 胰腺的「葡萄糖传感器」，决定胰岛素分泌的血糖阈值。
en: The pancreas's glucose sensor, setting the blood-sugar threshold for insulin release.

name: Homeostatic Iron Regulator
zh: 铁代谢调节蛋白，C282Y 突变导致遗传性血色病（铁过载）。
en: Its C282Y mutation causes hereditary hemochromatosis (iron overload).

name: Proprotein Convertase Subtilisin/Kexin 9
zh: 降解 LDL 受体的蛋白，抑制它的抗体成为降胆固醇明星药物。
en: Degrades LDL receptors; antibody drugs against it powerfully lower cholesterol.

name: Peroxisome Proliferator-activated Receptor Gamma
zh: 脂肪生成与胰岛素敏感性的主调控因子，糖尿病药物靶点。
en: Master regulator of fat-cell formation and insulin sensitivity.

name: Uncoupling Protein 1
zh: 棕色脂肪产热的关键蛋白，把能量直接转化为热量而非 ATP。
en: Lets brown fat burn energy as heat instead of storing it as ATP.

name: MHC Class I B
zh: 人类多态性最高的基因之一，决定器官移植配型与免疫识别。
en: One of the most variable human genes; it governs transplant matching.

name: C-C Chemokine Receptor 5
zh: HIV 入侵免疫细胞的「共受体」，Δ32 突变者天然抵抗艾滋病毒。
en: HIV's co-receptor; Δ32 carriers are naturally resistant to AIDS.

name: Interleukin 2 Receptor Gamma
zh: 共同 γ 链，缺陷导致 X 连锁重症联合免疫缺陷（「泡泡男孩」病）。
en: Defects cause X-linked SCID, the 'bubble boy' disease.

name: Adenosine Deaminase
zh: 缺陷导致 SCID，1990 年它成为人类史上第一例基因治疗的靶基因。
en: Its 1990 gene-therapy trial was the first in human history.

name: Forkhead Box P3
zh: 调节性 T 细胞的「身份决定者」，维持免疫耐受、防止自身免疫。
en: The identity factor of regulatory T cells, guarding against autoimmunity.

name: Recombination Activating Gene 1
zh: 启动 V(D)J 重排的重组酶，没有它就没有抗体的多样性。
en: Initiates V(D)J recombination — the source of antibody diversity.

name: Interferon Gamma
zh: 抗病毒与抗肿瘤免疫的核心细胞因子。
en: A core cytokine of antiviral and antitumor immunity.

name: Tumor Necrosis Factor
zh: 强效炎症因子，也是类风湿关节炎生物制剂的靶点。
en: A potent inflammatory cytokine and the target of blockbuster biologics.

name: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 1
zh: 干扰素信号的关键传递者，缺陷者对病毒几乎不设防。
en: Relays interferon signals; deficient patients are defenseless against viruses.

name: Angiotensin-converting Enzyme 2
zh: 血压调节酶，也是 SARS-CoV-2 病毒进入细胞的大门。
en: A blood-pressure enzyme and the entry door for SARS-CoV-2.

name: Amyloid Precursor Protein
zh: 其切割产物 β-淀粉样蛋白的沉积是阿尔茨海默病的标志。
en: Its cleavage product, β-amyloid, forms the plaques of Alzheimer's disease.

name: Alpha-synuclein
zh: 突触核蛋白，异常聚集形成路易小体，导致帕金森病。
en: Its aggregates form Lewy bodies in Parkinson's disease.

name: Microtubule-associated Protein Tau
zh: Tau 蛋白过度磷酸化缠结是阿尔茨海默病的另一标志。
en: Hyperphosphorylated tau tangles mark Alzheimer's and other dementias.

name: Superoxide Dismutase 1
zh: 抗氧化酶，特定突变导致肌萎缩侧索硬化（渐冻症，ALS）。
en: An antioxidant enzyme; certain mutations cause ALS.

name: Brain-derived Neurotrophic Factor
zh: 大脑的「肥料」，支持神经元存活、学习与记忆。
en: Fertilizer for the brain: supports neurons, learning, and memory.

name: Dopamine Receptor D2
zh: 多巴胺受体，多数抗精神病药物的作用靶点。
en: The dopamine receptor targeted by most antipsychotic drugs.

name: Serotonin Transporter
zh: 5-羟色胺转运体，SSRI 类抗抑郁药的靶点。
en: The serotonin transporter, target of SSRI antidepressants.

name: Catechol-O-methyltransferase
zh: 降解多巴胺的酶，其活性差异影响压力下的认知表现。
en: Degrades dopamine; activity variants shape cognition under stress.

name: Monoamine Oxidase A
zh: 分解单胺类神经递质，因与环境的互作被称为「战士基因」。
en: Breaks down monoamine transmitters; dubbed the 'warrior gene'.

name: Oxytocin Receptor
zh: 催产素受体，与信任、亲密和社会联结有关。
en: The oxytocin receptor, linked to trust and social bonding.

name: SHANK3 Scaffold Protein
zh: 突触支架蛋白，缺失导致 Phelan-McDermid 综合征和自闭症。
en: A synaptic scaffold; its deletion causes an autism-linked syndrome.

name: NMDA Receptor Subunit 2B
zh: NMDA 受体亚基，对学习记忆和神经发育至关重要。
en: An NMDA-receptor subunit vital for learning and development.

name: Sodium Channel Alpha Subunit 1
zh: 钠通道基因，突变导致 Dravet 综合征等严重癫痫。
en: A sodium channel; mutations cause severe epilepsies like Dravet syndrome.

name: Presenilin 1
zh: γ-分泌酶核心成分，突变导致早发型家族性阿尔茨海默病。
en: Core of γ-secretase; mutations cause early-onset familial Alzheimer's.

name: Sex-determining Region Y
zh: Y 染色体上的「总开关」，启动胚胎向男性方向发育。
en: The Y-chromosome master switch that triggers male development.

name: Sonic Hedgehog
zh: 刺猬信号通路蛋白，塑造胚胎的前后轴、四肢和神经管图案。
en: A morphogen patterning the embryo's axes, limbs, and neural tube.

name: Homeobox D13
zh: Hox 家族成员，决定肢体末端的「身份地图」，突变导致并指多指。
en: A Hox gene mapping limb identity; mutations fuse or duplicate digits.

name: Paired Box 6
zh: 眼睛发育的「主控基因」，从果蝇到人类都靠它启动眼的形成。
en: The master control gene for eye development across the animal kingdom.

name: SRY-box Transcription Factor 9
zh: 软骨与性腺发育的关键因子，突变导致骨骼发育不良。
en: Key for cartilage and gonad development; mutations cause skeletal dysplasia.

name: Fibroblast Growth Factor Receptor 3
zh: 一个点突变（G380R）导致软骨发育不全，是最常见的侏儒症病因。
en: One mutation causes achondroplasia, the most common form of dwarfism.

name: T-box Transcription Factor 5
zh: 心脏与前肢发育的调控者，突变导致心手综合征。
en: Patterns heart and forelimb; mutations cause Holt-Oram syndrome.

name: GLI Family Zinc Finger 3
zh: SHH 通路的转录效应因子，突变导致多种多指畸形。
en: A SHH-pathway effector; mutations cause polydactyly syndromes.

name: Notch Receptor 1
zh: 细胞间「邻居通讯」受体，决定发育中细胞的命运抉择。
en: A cell-to-cell communication receptor deciding cell fates.

name: Wnt Family Member 3
zh: Wnt 信号配体，早期胚胎图式形成的奠基信号之一。
en: A Wnt ligand foundational to early embryonic patterning.

name: Forkhead Box P2
zh: 首个与语言相关的基因，人类版本与黑猩猩仅差两个氨基酸。
en: The first language-linked gene; humans differ from chimps by two amino acids.

name: Melanocortin 1 Receptor
zh: 红发与白皙皮肤的决定基因，也是紫外线敏感度的开关。
en: The red-hair, fair-skin gene and a switch for UV sensitivity.

name: Oculocutaneous Albinism 2
zh: 虹膜颜色的主要决定者，与 HERC2 共同控制蓝眼与棕眼。
en: The main determinant of iris color, switched by neighboring HERC2.

name: HERC2
zh: 其内含子中的一段增强子像「开关」一样远程调控 OCA2，决定蓝眼睛。
en: An enhancer inside it remotely toggles OCA2, producing blue eyes.

name: Solute Carrier Family 24 Member 5
zh: 影响黑色素合成，是人类肤色演化的关键基因之一。
en: A pigmentation gene central to human skin-color evolution.

name: Tyrosinase
zh: 黑色素合成的限速酶，完全失活导致眼皮肤白化病。
en: The rate-limiting enzyme of melanin; its loss causes albinism.

name: Rhodopsin
zh: 视紫红质，感光细胞捕捉光子的分子，突变导致视网膜色素变性。
en: The photon catcher of rod cells; mutations cause retinitis pigmentosa.

name: Long-wave-sensitive Opsin 1
zh: 红敏视锥蛋白，位于 X 染色体，其异常导致红绿色盲（男性多见）。
en: The red cone pigment on the X chromosome behind red-green color blindness.

name: Gap Junction Protein Beta 2
zh: 连接蛋白 26，突变是最常见的遗传性耳聋病因，新生儿筛查必查。
en: Connexin 26; its mutations are the most common inherited deafness cause.

name: Myosin VIIA
zh: 内耳毛细胞的马达蛋白，突变导致 Usher 综合征（耳聋伴失明）。
en: An inner-ear motor protein; mutations cause Usher syndrome.

name: Taste Receptor 2 Type 38
zh: 苦味受体，决定你能否尝出 PTC 的苦味，遗传课经典实验。
en: A bitter receptor deciding whether you taste PTC — a classic genetics demo.

name: Olfactory Receptor 6A2
zh: 嗅觉受体，与「香菜闻起来像肥皂」的个体差异有关。
en: An olfactory receptor linked to cilantro tasting like soap.

name: Alpha-actinin 3
zh: 快肌纤维蛋白，R577X 多态被称为「速度基因」，与短跑天赋相关。
en: A fast-twitch muscle protein; the famous 'sprint gene'.

name: Hemoglobin Subunit Alpha 1
zh: α-珠蛋白，缺失导致地中海贫血，疟疾选择压力塑造了它的分布。
en: α-globin; deletions cause thalassemia, a distribution shaped by malaria.

name: Von Willebrand Factor
zh: 血小板黏附的「分子胶水」，缺陷导致最常见的遗传性出血病。
en: Molecular glue for platelets; deficiency causes the commonest bleeding disorder.

name: Myosin Heavy Chain 7
zh: 心肌马达蛋白，突变是肥厚型心肌病的首要病因。
en: A cardiac motor protein; mutations are the leading cause of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

name: Sodium Channel Alpha Subunit 5
zh: 心脏钠通道，突变导致长 QT 综合征与 Brugada 综合征。
en: The cardiac sodium channel behind long-QT and Brugada syndromes.

name: Titin
zh: 人体最大的蛋白质，像分子弹簧一样维持肌肉弹性，突变导致心肌病。
en: The largest human protein, a molecular spring; mutations cause cardiomyopathy.

name: Ryanodine Receptor 1
zh: 肌肉钙释放通道，突变可在麻醉时诱发恶性高热。
en: The muscle calcium-release channel; mutations can trigger malignant hyperthermia.

name: Erythropoietin Receptor
zh: 促红细胞生成素受体，天然突变造就过越野滑雪传奇运动员。
en: EPO's receptor; a natural variant created an Olympic skiing legend.

name: Myostatin
zh: 肌肉生长的「刹车」，失活的个体天生肌肉发达（如比利时蓝牛）。
en: The muscle-growth brake; its loss creates double-muscled animals and humans.

name: Circadian Locomotor Output Cycles Kaput
zh: 生物钟核心转录因子，让身体知道「现在几点」。
en: A core clock transcription factor telling the body what time it is.
